kdp_keywords_for_recommended_T1.evidence: Accurate story tone: the linked mystery is restrained rather than action-driven (outline/outline.md:35-40,60-79).
Ana is the viewpoint and decision-making lead throughout the ten-story spine (bible/cast.md; outline/outline.md:60-79).
Town residents evade Ana's questions while revealing pieces of the past (outline/outline.md:68-79).
The central plot concerns what Puerto Lento will and will not say about Tomás and the letters (outline/outline.md:68-79).
Ana works nights in a coastal harbor town and the recurring light is a central visual motif (outline/outline.md:60-79).
Tomás's long absence and its effects on Lucía, Rosa, and the town drive the volume's emotional history (outline/outline.md:68-79).
The evidence-backed A2 starting state assumes prior beginner study and excludes absolute beginners (research/niche.md:24-33; edits/fact-report.md:F-001).
